top_signals.title: Tata Group Erases $4.5 Billion in Value as Chairman Plans Exit
top_signals.summary: Shares of India’s Tata Group companies wiped out 433 billion rupees ($4.5 billion) in market value Wednesday after Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran said he will step down when his term ends in February, deepening a leadership crisis.

top_signals.summary: A Fifa referee labelled the worst at the World Cup was experiencing a level of heat strain associated with impaired decision making, new data has revealed.
